title: 🔧 Arabic Keyboard Fixer
subtitle: Type or paste mixed-layout text and get an instant fix
labels.historyNotice: History is off — nothing you type here is stored. Turn it on and the last 20 corrections are kept in your browser only, and cleared automatically after 24 hours. Do not paste passwords.
labels.keyboardInfoBody: Both the base and Shift layers of the Arabic 101 layout are supported, and mistyped words are detected one word at a time. The Arabic 102 layout is temporarily disabled until its table is verified.
labels.footer: Arabic Keyboard Fixer v1.2 | Runs entirely in your browser — no data leaves the page.
placeholder.input: Example: g]d la;gm td hg;jhfm fg,pm hglthjdp (Arabic text typed on an English layout)
aria.swap: Force conversion in the opposite direction
messages.historyOn: History on — it will be saved in your browser
messages.historyOff: History off, and anything stored was deleted
messages.tooLong: Text is longer than {n} characters — analysis is paused and your text is untouched. Trim it or convert it in batches.
messages.localeFailed: ⚠ Could not load the language file — run the app over HTTP
empty.suggestionsIdle: Start typing or paste mixed-layout text here…
empty.suggestionsNone: No keyboard-layout issue detected — use the ⇄ button to force a conversion
